data.situation:
A week later, the reading group received funding for new books. Noor brought the letter to the meeting table, and an exuberant member immediately began planning a celebration. The group was jubilant about the news: the shelves would finally hold the titles they had requested. Ben, usually taciturn in a busy room, listened while others discussed music and photographs. Someone had already put his name beside a short speech on the invitation. He raised the paper and asked who had agreed to that. Noor thought it was presumptuous to assign him the role without asking. The name was removed, and Ben was offered the choice of speaking, helping with the books or simply coming to the celebration. Another member tried to cajole Ben into joining the group photograph by promising to save him a place beside the new shelves. He laughed and agreed to the photograph. When the organiser proposed a quieter ending to the evening, the exuberant member acquiesced in the plan, though he had hoped to keep the music going longer. Noor wrote the agreed arrangements on a fresh invitation and left the old one under her cup. Revised invitation
We are jubilant about the funding and would like to celebrate the new books on Friday. Come for the conversation and the photograph; helping with the shelves or making a short speech is optional. If you would like a role, tell Noor which one. Music will finish before the final reading, as agreed at the meeting. Ben: I'm happy about the books. I just don't want my name on a speech I haven't agreed to give.
Noor: That was presumptuous. I've taken it off. Would you like to help with the shelves?
Ben: Yes, and I'll join the photograph.
Member: I would have liked more music, but I'll go along with the quieter plan.
Noor: Good. I'll send the invitation with those choices clear.

Someone had already put his name beside a short speech on the invitation. He raised the paper and asked who had agreed to that. Noor thought it was presumptuous to assign him the role without asking. The name was removed, and Ben was offered the choice of speaking, helping with the books or simply coming to the celebration. Another member tried to cajole Ben into joining the group photograph by promising to save him a place beside the new shelves. He laughed and agreed to the photograph. When the organiser proposed a quieter ending to the evening, the exuberant member acquiesced in the plan, though he had hoped to keep the music going longer. Noor wrote the agreed arrangements on a fresh invitation and left the old one under her cup.
readingBlocks.zh: 一周后，阅读小组拿到购置新书的资金。努尔把信带到会议桌旁，一位热情洋溢的成员立即开始筹办庆祝活动。大家为消息喜气洋洋，书架终于能放上申请的书了。班在热闹房间里通常寡言，听其他人讨论音乐与合影。有人已经在邀请函的简短发言一栏写上了他的名字。他举起纸，问谁同意了这个安排。努尔觉得，没有先问就给他分配角色很冒昧。大家删去名字，让班选择发言、帮忙摆书，或只来参加庆祝。另一位成员许诺在新书架旁给他留位置，试着劝他参加合影。他笑着同意拍照。组织者提出晚会后半段安静些，热情的成员虽想再放一会儿音乐，仍勉强同意了方案。努尔把商定安排写到新的邀请函上，将旧纸压在杯子下。

readingBlocks.en:
Revised invitation
We are jubilant about the funding and would like to celebrate the new books on Friday. Come for the conversation and the photograph; helping with the shelves or making a short speech is optional. If you would like a role, tell Noor which one. Music will finish before the final reading, as agreed at the meeting.
readingBlocks.zh:
修改后的邀请
我们为拨款感到喜悦，想在星期五一起庆祝新书到来。欢迎来聊天、合影，帮忙摆书或作简短发言均可自选。想承担角色，请告诉努尔希望做什么。按会议商定，最后的朗读开始前，音乐会结束。

readingBlocks.en:
Ben: I'm happy about the books. I just don't want my name on a speech I haven't agreed to give.
Noor: That was presumptuous. I've taken it off. Would you like to help with the shelves?
Ben: Yes, and I'll join the photograph.
Member: I would have liked more music, but I'll go along with the quieter plan.
Noor: Good. I'll send the invitation with those choices clear.
readingBlocks.zh:
班：我为新书高兴，只是不想被写进一项没同意的发言安排。
努尔：那个安排很冒昧，我已经删了。想帮忙摆书吗？
班：想，也会参加合影。
成员：我本想多放点音乐，不过还是按安静些的方案来吧。
努尔：好，我把这些选择写清楚后发邀请。

glossary.zh: 热情洋溢的；精力充沛的
glossary.note: 形容词描述明显热情与活力；不是所有赞同的人都exuberant，不覆盖辞藻或颜色的其他义。
glossary.example: An exuberant member immediately began planning a celebration.
glossary.exampleZh: 一位热情洋溢的成员立即开始筹办庆祝活动。

glossary.zh: 因成功或好消息而喜悦的
glossary.note: 形容词be jubilant about/at；本句因收到资金而欢喜，与一般活泼性格分开。
glossary.example: The group was jubilant about the news.

externalEvidence.definition: joyful and proud especially because of triumph or success

glossary.note: 形容词；本故事描述常见说话方式，不把一次安静当作拒绝、能力不足或诊断。
glossary.example: Ben was usually taciturn in a busy room.
glossary.exampleZh: 班在热闹房间里通常寡言。

glossary.zh: 默许；不积极赞同但接受
glossary.note: 正式不及物动词acquiesce in + 安排；本故事有口头同意，不由沉默推断已同意。
glossary.example: The member acquiesced in the quieter plan.
glossary.exampleZh: 那位成员勉强同意了安静些的方案。

glossary.note: 开放框架cajole somebody into + -ing，常带讨好或甜言劝诱意味；本句tried表示尝试，不自动说明对方已经同意。
glossary.example: A member tried to cajole Ben into joining the group photograph.
glossary.exampleZh: 一位成员试着劝班参加合影。

externalEvidence.label: Cambridge Dictionary
externalEvidence.reviewFinding: Explicit cajole someone into something/doing something entry confirms argument slots and -ing complement.

glossary.zh: 冒昧的；自以为有权作某事的
glossary.note: 形容词it is presumptuous to ...；描述未经许可越过权限的行为，不只等于说话音量大。
glossary.example: It was presumptuous to assign him the role without asking.
glossary.exampleZh: 没有先问就给他分配角色很冒昧。

retrievalPrompts.cue: Tell someone who missed the meeting about the good news and how two members reacted.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 给未到会的同伴描述庆祝消息与两个人的表现。
acceptableAnswers: The group was jubilant about the funding. An exuberant member wanted to organise the music, while Ben was usually taciturn in the busy room and preferred to help with the shelves.

retrievalPrompts.cue: Explain the revised invitation and give Ben a choice about taking part.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 解释为什么修改邀请函，并给班保留选择。
acceptableAnswers: It was presumptuous to assign Ben a speech without asking him. We removed his name and offered him a choice of roles. Trying to cajole somebody into joining a photograph is not the same as assigning them a speech.

retrievalPrompts.cue: Say what you would have preferred while accepting the final arrangement.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 表达自己希望有所不同，但仍接受最后商定的安排。
acceptableAnswers: I would have liked the music to continue longer, but I will acquiesce in the quieter plan for the final reading.

transferPrompt.cue: A club invitation assigns someone the hosting role without asking. Write a correction that leaves the decision to them.
transferPrompt.cueZh: 社团邀请函未经询问就给某人安排主持。写一条更自然的修正消息，让对方选择是否参加。
acceptableAnswers: It was presumptuous to put your name beside the hosting role before asking. We have removed it. We are jubilant about the event and would love you to come, whether or not you want a role.
